The ISM represents the considered advice of the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD). This advice is provided in accordance with ASD’s designated functions under the [Intelligence Services Act 2001](#bf76a2ec-3cf5-4a02-839a-7b2ea11cb3fc).

ASD also provides cyber security advice in the form of Australian Communications Security Instructions and other cyber security-related publications. In these cases, operating system, application and device-specific advice may take precedence over the advice in the ISM.
